mods.name: Item Get!
mods.description: Create cinematic, configurable first-time and milestone reminders with a visual editor for modpacks.

releases.notes:
## 更新内容
- 修复触发 GUI 触发条件过多时无法继续向下配置的问题，触发页的逻辑按钮和条件列表会一起按新的视口布局避让。
- 管理器筛选从循环按钮改为下拉菜单，点击外部只关闭菜单，不会穿透到底层列表。
- 多条件提醒的列表/预览副标题改为轮播具体条件，避免显示“任意满足：3 个条件”这种不清晰摘要。
- 提醒弹窗和侧边提示新增 JEI 快捷入口：同一条提醒可同时显示 JEI、机械动力思索、思索者入口，分别用 J/O/P 打开。
- 修复 JEI 15.x 运行时接入方式，加入插件接收 IJeiRuntime，并保留诊断日志。
- 手册锁定图标去掉突兀亮点，联动按钮显示逻辑与解锁状态保持一致。
- 补全并修复中文语言文件，新增文本不再依赖硬编码显示。

## 验证
- Forge 1.20.1：`./gradlew.bat build` 通过。
- JAR SHA-256：D5FE888B718F05FFEFA97908B6A80BC9ADA77808C8C1B9AC767586A98F3F770A

## Changes
- Fixed the Trigger GUI list limit issue where too many trigger conditions could no longer be scrolled/configured; the trigger logic button and condition list now share a safer viewport layout.
- Changed the manager filter from a cycling button to a dropdown menu. Outside clicks close the menu without activating rows underneath.
- Changed multi-condition rule previews to rotate through concrete condition summaries instead of showing unclear count text such as “Any met: 3 conditions”.
- Added JEI shortcuts to full reminder popups and side reminders. A single reminder can now expose JEI, Create Ponder, and Ponderer actions in parallel with J/O/P.
- Fixed JEI 15.x runtime integration by adding a plugin that receives `IJeiRuntime`, with diagnostic logging kept for runtime, target, and open failures.
- Removed the inconsistent bright pixel from locked handbook icons and kept integration buttons aligned with unlock/link availability.
- Completed and repaired Simplified Chinese localization; new visible text no longer depends on hardcoded strings.

## Verification
- Forge 1.20.1: `./gradlew.bat build` passed.
- JAR SHA-256: D5FE888B718F05FFEFA97908B6A80BC9ADA77808C8C1B9AC767586A98F3F770A

releases.notes:
## Item Get! v1.0.4

Added:
- New trigger type: Dimension Changed.
- New trigger type: Manual Trigger for command blocks, datapack functions, KubeJS, scene blocks, NPC dialogue, and other mods.
- Public Java API: ItemGetApi.trigger, show, unlock, reset, isUnlocked, and fireExternalTrigger.
- Server commands for direct rule triggering and manual trigger ids.
- External Trigger Guide in docs.
- Downloadable Codex skill for generating and validating config/item_get/rules.json.

Changed:
- Manual Trigger rules can be edited directly in the in-game editor.
- Manual Trigger entries appear in manager, handbook, and filters.
- trigger/fire show the reminder, mark progress, and record it in the handbook.
- show only displays the reminder without changing progress or handbook history.

Fixed / Improved:
- Improved command suggestions for rule ids and manual trigger ids.
- Handbook history avoids duplicate entries for the same rule revision.

releases.notes:
Bugfix release for Forge 1.20.1.

- Reminder rules now save globally to config/item_get/rules.json, so they apply to every world in the instance/modpack.
- Existing per-world rules are migrated automatically only when the global rule file does not exist yet.
- Empty global rule files are respected, so deleted rules will not be restored from old worlds.
- Per-player trigger progress remains world/player-specific.
